mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced cost of capital for corporate investment.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 4.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 5.0% signals aggressive monetary tightening that raises borrowing costs and suppresses corporate earnings growth, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high housing starts (HOUST) and low unemployment (UNRATE) indicate robust consumer demand and labor market strength, supporting corporate revenue growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST exceeds 1600 and UNRATE is below 4.5%, or interaction term Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a tight labor market (UNRATE < 4.5%), wage growth accelerates and consumer spending increases, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days through sustained household consumption.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE is below 4.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High industrial production (INDPRO) reflects strong manufacturing activity and economic momentum, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO exceeds 110, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 105 (INDPRO) signals economic contraction, reducing corporate investment and earnings growth, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is below 105, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous monetary tightening (FEDFUNDS > 5.0%) and tight labor market (UNRATE < 4.5%) indicate overheating economy with rising recession risk, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.

failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.0% and UNRATE is below 4.5%, or interaction term Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.
